rate_match.aggregate_optimality: largest achievable total <= target over retained native candidate pairs
rate_match.reuse_policy: freeze this exact mapping across both BPG branches and every channel condition

codec_build.build_command: CMake3.28.3 explicit8/10/12bit configure; make -j2 bpgenc bpgdec USE_BPGVIEW= USE_JCTVC= CMAKE_OPTS=-DENABLE_LIBNUMA=OFF
codec_build.redistribution: Do not commit codecs/DLLs to GitHub. Upstream encoder GPLv2, decoder mixed BSD/LGPL2.1; see bundled licenses.

ldpc.name: systematic_ra_2048_1536_seeded_v1
ldpc.decoder: flooding normalized min-sum with syndrome early stopping
ldpc.matrix_assumption: H=[seeded balanced column-weight-3 A | lower-bidiagonal D]

paper_eq3_4_background_only.basis: Chen et al. Eq. (3) defines n(t) as background-light noise; Eq. (4) gives its collected optical power. No receiver shot or ASE term is printed in those equations.
limitations: Eq. (4) optical background power to complex matched-filter variance is an implementation approximation, not a disclosed receiver transfer.
FOV unit, optical filter width, Malaga phase/beta, fading coherence and proprietary coherent receiver/DSP details remain assumptions.
Background-only omission of quantum shot noise is an equation-level idealization, not a physically complete coherent receiver.
ASE bandwidth/post-EDFA launch reference and shot bandwidth/polarization are inferred; neither establishes the undisclosed VPI configuration.

provenance.published_channel: Chen et al., Sec. II-B, Eqs. (3)-(4); Table I
provenance.selection_rule: Choose explicitly before examining evaluation outcomes.

coherent_receiver_extension_v6.basis: Unchanged v6 interpretation: background plus propagated transmitter EDFA ASE and input-referred single-polarization heterodyne shot noise.
limitations: Eq. (4) optical background power to complex matched-filter variance is an implementation approximation, not a disclosed receiver transfer.
FOV unit, optical filter width, Malaga phase/beta, fading coherence and proprietary coherent receiver/DSP details remain assumptions.
Background-only omission of quantum shot noise is an equation-level idealization, not a physically complete coherent receiver.
ASE bandwidth/post-EDFA launch reference and shot bandwidth/polarization are inferred; neither establishes the undisclosed VPI configuration.

rect8_repair.scope: rectangular 8QAM only; QPSK and 16QAM use unchanged v1
rect8_repair.coarse_cfr: v1 fourth-power FFT and Newton periodogram refinement
rect8_repair.fine_cfr: received-sample constellation-distance likelihood; frequency and constant phase jointly fitted
rect8_repair.cpr: two windowed decision-directed ML phase updates, arg(sum(y*conj(decision)))
rect8_repair.acquisition_search: one unoversampled fourth-harmonic CFO bin either side of the coarse estimate
rect8_repair.acquisition_samples: at most 2048 uniformly spaced received samples; no data-dependent sampling
rect8_repair.phase_trials_and_window: unchanged SignalDSPConfig phase count and window length
rect8_repair.phase_ambiguity: initial phase branch nearest zero; unidentifiable likelihood ties use that convention
rect8_repair.amplitude_default: known positive real block magnitude only, as in v1
rect8_repair.failure_policy: estimates and errors retained; no frame rejection
rect8_repair.related_work_scope: estimator-family motivation only; neither paper's exact algorithm is reproduced

protocol.side_information: perfect frame boundaries/filelength; block magnitude/noise PSD known; true phase unknown
protocol.channel_pairing: same seed/fading draw, not identical waveforms across different payload lengths
protocol.fairness: matched aggregate source bitrate; per-image rate may differ; actual FEC/padding/coded bits reported; NOT equal channel uses
